titleText: Repeat offender jailed, faces deportation after driving stolen car
mainText: From Times of Malta: Repeat offender jailed, faces deportation after driving stolen car. The 21-year-old was found guilty for driving without an insurance policy and licence

titleText: Malta reaffirms commitment to strengthening relations with China
mainText: From Times of Malta: Malta reaffirms commitment to strengthening relations with China. Discussions included EU-China relations, war in Ukraine and the recent trilateral summit in Shenzhen

titleText: Two jailed following illegal entry into Malta on dinghy from Libya
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Two jailed following illegal entry into Malta on dinghy from Libya. Two men were each sentenced to two years in prison on Tuesday after admitting to immigration-related offences, including helping others aboard the same dinghy enter Malta illegally.

titleText: Two Pembroke sites to be transformed into recreation area and dog park under Lands Authority deal
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Two Pembroke sites to be transformed into recreation area and dog park under Lands Authority deal. Two parcels of public land in Pembroke are set to be handed over to the Pembroke Local Council for development into a recreation zone and a dog park, following an agreement signed with the Lands Authority.

titleText: WATCH | Abela non-committal on annual 14,000 net population increase
mainText: From MaltaToday: WATCH | Abela non-committal on annual 14,000 net population increase. Budget measures targeting non-EU workers are expected to slow the population growth rate not reverse the trend, Robert Abela said in comments to MaltaToday. However, the prime minister was unable to provide projections on the deceleration rate when pressed on the matter.
